assessments.rationale: The credentials section affirmatively states the credential is provisioned through the standard workload deployment, and the asserted organizational control states that credentials provisioned that way live in the enterprise secrets service and rotate on a ninety-day schedule. The two passages together name the secret store, which is what the requirement asks the documentation to state.
The cited passage states the reachability restriction as a fact of the deployment; no passage establishes what enforces it, so the restriction cannot be verified from what was supplied.
